queries.description: Verify latest ledger reconciliation runs and discrepancy status across accounts
queries.sql: SELECT r.id, r.paper_account_id, a.name AS account_name, r.status, r.recalculated_balance, r.stored_balance, r.recalculated_equity, r.stored_equity, r.discrepancy_count, r.completed_at FROM reconciliation_runs r JOIN paper_accounts a ON r.paper_account_id = a.id ORDER BY r.completed_at DESC LIMIT 8;

queries.description: Inspect canonical vs superseded counterfactual evaluations count and slot uniqueness
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rows, COUNT(CASE WHEN superseded_by IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS canonical_rows, COUNT(CASE WHEN superseded_by IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS superseded_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT (strategy_id || '|' || strategy_version || '|' || symbol || '|' || timeframe || '|' || decision_time::text)) AS distinct_slots FROM counterfactual_evaluations;

queries.description: Strategy observations distribution by strategy_id, side, and quality class
queries.sql: SELECT strategy_id, side, quality_class, COUNT(*) AS count FROM strategy_observations GROUP BY strategy_id, side, quality_class ORDER BY strategy_id, side;

queries.description: Risk decisions distribution by paper_account_id, allowed flag, and risk_version
queries.sql: SELECT paper_account_id, allowed, risk_version, COUNT(*) AS count FROM risk_decisions GROUP BY paper_account_id, allowed, risk_version ORDER BY paper_account_id, allowed;

queries.description: Inspect registered ML model artifacts, statuses, and Gate 6 validation flags
queries.sql: SELECT id, name, model_type, version, status, parameters->>'gate6_validation' AS gate6_validation_raw, parameters->>'approved_for_advisory' AS approved_for_advisory, created_at FROM learning_model_artifacts ORDER BY created_at DESC;

queries.description: Verify presence of partial unique indexes enforcing slot idempotency and account uniqueness
queries.sql: SELECT schemaname, tablename, indexname, indexdef FROM pg_indexes WHERE tablename IN ('counterfactual_evaluations', 'strategy_observations', 'risk_decisions') AND indexname LIKE '%unique%' ORDER BY tablename, indexname;

rows.indexdef: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX counterfactual_evaluations_signal_unique ON public.counterfactual_evaluations USING btree (signal_id) WHERE ((signal_id IS NOT NULL) AND (superseded_by IS NULL))

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX counterfactual_evaluations_slot_unique ON public.counterfactual_evaluations USING btree (strategy_id, strategy_version, symbol, timeframe, decision_time) WHERE (superseded_by IS NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX risk_decisions_paper_account_id_signal_id_risk_version_unique ON public.risk_decisions USING btree (paper_account_id, signal_id, risk_version)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX strategy_observations_slot_unique ON public.strategy_observations USING btree (exchange, category, symbol, strategy_id, strategy_version, decision_time) WHERE (superseded_by IS NULL)
